title: Customer-Pay Labor Charges and Deductible Rows — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Clause.** Under Service Accounts and Repair Orders, customer-pay labor is billed at flat-rate hours times the posted labor rate of the store that wrote the repair order, giving the labor list amount. The tier's labor discount is applied to the list amount and the result is rounded to the cent. The labor discount in dollars on one repair order may not exceed the tier's largest labor discount per repair order, and any discount beyond that cap is not given.

**Deductibles.** A deductible owed on covered work is posted as a labor charge whose basis is a service contract deductible or a warranty deductible, with 0.0 hours and the deductible amount, and it receives no discount.

**Covered work.** Work paid by a manufacturer warranty, a recall, a service contract or a maintenance plan is never billed to the customer here; it is recorded in that program's own records.

## The figure, in words
- The list amount is the flat-rate hours multiplied by the posted rate of the writing store, rounded to the cent.
- The labor charged is the list amount less the tier's labor discount share of it, rounded to the cent, with the discount in dollars held to the per-repair-order cap.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)
| Hours | Posted rate | Tier discount share | Cap | List amount | Discount given | Labor charged |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2.5 | 140.00 | 10% | 100.00 | 350.00 | 35.00 | 315.00 |
| 9.0 | 140.00 | 10% | 100.00 | 1260.00 | 100.00 (126.00 held to the cap) | 1160.00 |
| 0.0 (deductible) | — | none | — | — | none | the deductible amount |
